//@version=5
indicator("EMA cross", overlay=true)
fast = input.int(20, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
slow = input.int(50, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
longSignal = ta.crossover(ta.ema(close, fast), ta.ema(close, slow))
plotshape(longSignal)
alertcondition(longSignal, "EMA cross up")
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
